quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration (H1 2026, unnamed): customer A KRW 99,494,423 thousand, 55.13% of consolidated revenue (H1 2025: KRW 80,983,301 thousand, 52.93%); customer B KRW 30,549,733 thousand, 16.93% (H1 2025: 16.63%). The report names its customer base as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, Micron, TSMC, DB HiTek and Magnachip Semiconductor in semiconductors; Samsung Display, LG Display, BOE and CSOT in displays; Samsung Electronics' LED business; and SK Siltron. It has supplied Samsung Electronics' Pyeongtaek fab and SK Hynix M14 and M15, and began supplying COS to Samsung Electronics.
quarterly_data.figure: customer A KRW 99,494,423 thousand (55.13%); customer B KRW 30,549,733 thousand (16.93%)

quarterly_data.signal: Production capacity for N2O and three other main items was 9,876,281 kg in H1 2026 with output of 6,727,663 kg, a utilisation rate of 68.12% (full-year 2025: 50.53%; 2024: 65.53%). Inventory rose to KRW 40,324,793 thousand from KRW 34,059,638 thousand at end-2025. The company says supply volumes are growing with 10nm-class DRAM demand and the expansion of high-layer 3D NAND processes.

Capex: the 2026 plan (January to December 2026) invests in buildings and machinery to expand production and R&D infrastructure. H1 cash spending was KRW 14,214M on property, plant and equipment and KRW 7,637M on investment property; construction in progress includes a KRW 45,661M land purchase (KB Real Estate Trust) and a KRW 12,891M construction contract (Shinwon General Development) expected to become land and buildings in 2026, plus a KRW 23,923M new head-office construction due to finish in November 2026. The company is also studying overseas warehouses near key global customers to run vendor-managed inventory, local quality-analysis labs, and import and distribution of specialty gases (business purposes added 2026-03-26).
quarterly_data.figure: PP&E acquisitions KRW 14,214M; land purchase KRW 45,661M; construction KRW 12,891M; head-office construction KRW 23,923M

quarterly_data.signal: The company says it is investing to respond to semiconductor technology changes (finer memory processes and next-generation HBM4/4E memory, more 3D NAND layers, foundry GAA and CFET adoption, EUV expansion) and to customers' new fab capacity: capacity additions for existing products, mass-production lines for newly developed products, R&D, automation and analysis systems. R&D spend KRW 6,197M in H1 2026 (3.43% of revenue); projects under development include next-generation dry etching gases, cleaning gases, metal and silicon precursors, low-GWP PFC replacement gases (GWP 150 or below) and ammonia-cracking hydrogen systems.
